method: Actual in-app browser UI and screenshots; real Spine timeline state checks are recorded separately

checks.name: Laffey cannon attack visibly changes the native pose and resolves enemy durability 3 to 1
Pausing preserves the attack pose across subsequent idle synchronization; resuming returns to standing
Bismarck main gun plays its distinct attack pose and sinks the 1-HP enemy Laffey
Sunken Laffey waits for impact, then keeps the collapsed final pose and fades instead of standing again
Bismarck moves three sea hexes from 20,23 to 23,23 with a movement pose; oil 50 to 47
Enterprise launch triggers its skill action; three 4-plane squadrons start with 20 AP and 4 turns, oil 47 to 38
Carrier pose changes through launch and resumes ambient animation after the clip
No browser console errors were captured during the scenario
Original 256-by-256 four-faction round-1 battle restored with 50 oil, 12 live friendly ships and no airborne squadrons; both animation and flight resumed

limits: Browser screenshots show representative DD, BB and CV poses; all 12 actual copied skeleton files and complete clip transitions are checked by the separate real-Spine test.
Current assets have no native hurt clip; hit feedback uses flash and shake.
Victory animation awaits the complete-match victory system.
